description: Creates a saved schematic from published catalog parts and verified pins. Supply name, requestId, intent and the existing guestToken for guest work. Omit boardEdits unless physical customization is requested; server defaults supply board settings, footprints, models and manufacturing limits. Account boards are personal unless organizationId is specified; a guest session supports one board. Use the returned id and revision directly as boardId and expectedRevision for generate_layout; no get_board call is needed just to obtain them. Use update_board for an existing board. Thin intent format: each parts entry is an array of strings [id, dbId, value], with an optional fourth designator. Choose id as the design-local part ID; copy dbId from the catalog result's id; value is the required value/display label. Omit the fourth designator when it matches id. Each connections entry is {net, class, pins}; class is power, signal, or ground. Each pins entry is [partId, padId]: use the design-local part ID and copy padId from the catalog result's pins[].number, both as strings. If validation rejects the proposal, preserve the schematic and valid catalog parts, correct the returned detailed issues, and keep the same account or guest session. Use a new requestId when input changes; reuse the same requestId and arguments for an unchanged retry. Research again only when an issue needs missing part or pin information; do not restart the guest session. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

segments.description: Connected lines/arcs; close explicitly; no zero lengths or crossings.

center.description: Board-frame center, equidistant from arc endpoints.

clockwise.description: True=clockwise, false=CCW; full circles need ≥2 arcs.

end.description: Arc end; unequal to prior end/start.

boardEdits.description: Physical patch; omitted fields retain existing values. settings changes only supplied app-supported settings (dimensions in mm). outline replaces the outline with a library choice or complete generated profile including retained cutouts. fixedPlacements uses design-local partId; mountingHoles, silkscreenTexts, and silkscreenSvgs use item id. Each collection uses upsert to add or merge items and remove to remove only listed IDs, not replace the collection. Removing a fixed placement unpins the part without deleting it. Positions are in board-plane mm; rotationDeg is counterclockwise degrees. Attached DXF and new SVG assets are unavailable through MCP. Existing SVG artwork can be edited or removed by item id; omit assetId.

upsert.description: Upsert by partId; retain omitted fields.

items.description: New unplaced parts require x and y or a relative position. Omitted coordinates inherit a saved fixed or realized pose; side/rotation alone require that pose.

alignment.description: X-axis: CCW tangent/inward normal; vertex bisector. Board-frame on both sides; no polarity/direction inference. Omit to retain rotation; excludes rotationDeg.

fraction.description: Outer-contour CCW arclength; 1=0. Start: rectangle (cornerRadius,0), circle bottom, custom profile.outer.start.

rotationOffsetDeg.description: CCW degrees added to required alignment; default 0.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

profile.description: Complete mm profile, retained cutouts; width 5–400, height 5–500; ≤2000 total segments. Omit width/height/diameter. Normalized origin/winding, 0.000001 mm precision.

cutouts.description: Closed voids ([]=none); prefer clockwise. Strictly inside; no touching, overlap or nesting.

allowedPartSides.description: Global policy; omission preserves supplied settings. Fixed placements must use a permitted side. Include any authorized policy change in the same patch; preserve explicit user side restrictions unless the user changes them.

copperPourClearanceMm.description: Copper pour clearance in mm to foreign copper: 0.10–1.00 for 1oz, 0.20–1.00 for 2oz; default 0.20. Null selects Automatic. Existing values outside this range remain valid when unchanged. Changes require regenerating the board.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

assetId.description: Attached SVG ID; required for new artwork.

upsert.description: Upsert by id; retain omitted fields.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

intent.description: Complete initial schematic using published catalog IDs and verified pins. Parts and connections use the thin intent format described by this tool.

maxTemperatureRiseC.description: Legacy: unchanged current requirements only; else omit. Regenerated layouts use 10°C above ambient.

items.description: [partId,padId] strings: local part ID, catalog pad number.

requiredCurrentA.description: Continuous A, all pins (mA/1000); omit for class widths.

targetImpedanceOhms.description: Single-ended ohms; no default. Honor device requirements. Pair targets go on differentialPairs.
Differential ohms; honor device requirements. Defaults: USB full/high-speed 90, LVDS 100, generic/custom none.

items.description: [id,dbId,value] strings; fourth designator if unlike id.

organizationId.description: Organization ID from list_organizations. Omit for personal account boards; guest sessions cannot use organizations.

requestId.description: New UUID for this operation. Reuse it with identical arguments when retrying an uncertain result; use a new UUID for a different operation.
